title: Recall pivots, special solutions and the complete solution

cards.front: What is the rank $r$ of a matrix?
cards.back: The number of pivots that elimination finds. Each pivot has a row and a column of its own.

cards.front: How do you find the special solutions of $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}$, and how many are there?
cards.back: Give one free variable the value $1$ and the other free variables $0$, then solve for the pivot variables. There is one for each free variable, $n - r$ in all.

cards.front: If $R = \begin{bmatrix} I & F \\ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$, what are the special solutions?
cards.back: The columns of $N = \begin{bmatrix} -F \\ I \end{bmatrix}$: $-F$ in the pivot variables and $I$ in the free variables.

cards.front: What is the complete solution of $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$?
cards.back: $\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{x}_p + \mathbf{x}_n$: one particular solution, for example with all free variables $0$, plus every vector $\mathbf{x}_n$ of the nullspace.

cards.front: What follows from full column rank $r = n$?
cards.back: No free variables, $N(A) = \mathbf{Z}$, and at most one solution of $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$.

cards.front: What follows from full row rank $r = m$?
cards.back: No zero rows, so $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ has a solution for every $\mathbf{b}$, with $n - m$ free variables.
